title: Untitled meeting
notes_markdown:
### Context

- Unscheduled chat in the kitchen after David submitted the travel-funding form

### Decisions

- Pilot onboarding = 45 min: 10 min their setup, 20 min connect + import live, 15 min first writing task with the trail
- Cut for the pilot build: Google Drive connector (OAuth review not done) → offer "Upload files" instead
- Keep: Claude, ChatGPT, Zotero, Local PDFs
- Import runs live during the session so we can watch failures; log every skipped item with a reason
- Ask pilots to bring one paragraph they're actively writing

### Open questions

- Does Claude export include project membership? (Hudson: no — need a second pass from the project pages; not for Oct 9)
- What to call the "Other" tile — leave as is for pilot A, watch what happens

### To do

- [ ] David — pilot script doc (timings, what to observe)
- [ ] Hudson — consent + recording note for pilots
- [ ] David — pre-flight: run full import on own accounts Oct 3

transcript.text: Wait, is this on? Oh, it auto-started. Okay whatever, leave it.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Did you submit it?

transcript.text: Submitted. Like twenty minutes ago. Travel funding is in. Grace will email if anything's wrong.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Proud of you. Before eleven.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Before eleven! Okay, while we're both here. Pilot onboarding. I keep thinking about how the session actually goes.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Yeah, let's just decide it.

transcript.text: Forty-five minutes. First ten, they show us their setup. Like the Berkeley interviews.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Okay.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Twenty, they connect stuff and we run the import live. While we watch.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Live, live? Not pre-imported?
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Live. I want to see it fail. If we pre-import, we'll hide the failures.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: That's scary but right.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: And the last fifteen, they write. They bring a paragraph they're actually working on, and we see if the trail finds anything.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Bring a paragraph. Good. Okay, what do we cut?
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Drive.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Drive?
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: The OAuth verification isn't done. If we put Drive on the screen and it shows the unverified-app warning, Priya will think we're a phishing site.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Ha. Fair. So the connect screen is Claude, ChatGPT, Zotero, PDFs, and "Other."
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: And "Other" is the file upload. Which covers Drive if they download stuff.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: I still don't love "Other."
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: I know. Let's watch Priya. If she's confused we change it before Daniel.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Deal. Oh, I checked the Claude export thing.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: And?
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: No project membership. The conversations are there, but nothing says which project they were in.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Ugh. So Priya's projects come in as the wall.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: As the wall. We'd need a second pass from the project pages. Not for the ninth.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Not for the ninth. Okay. Write it as a known gap. We tell her up front.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Tell her up front. I like that.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: And log every skipped item with a reason. If anything doesn't come in I want to know why. Like, the number.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: You're going to stare at the count.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: I'm going to stare at the count. Okay, I'll write a pilot script doc. Timings, what we watch for.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: I'll do the consent thing.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: And I'll do a full import on my own stuff on the third, before the dry run.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: The third is a Saturday.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Yeah, I know.
transcript.speaker: Me

transcript.text: Okay. Go to bed.
transcript.speaker: Hudson

transcript.text: Going. Turn this off — how do you stop it — okay.
